task.description:
Add missing unit tests for API-04 handlers in tests/unit/test_tasks_api.zig.

The TEST-RUNNER identified these test cases from tests/specs/API-04.md that are not yet implemented in the unit test file:

HIGH priority (add these):
- TC-API-04-23: GET /tasks/:id returns 404 for non-existent task (handleGetById 404 path)
- TC-API-04-43: POST /tasks/:id/assign 422 when user_id missing (handleAssign validation)
- TC-API-04-45: POST /tasks/:id/assign 422 when user_id empty string (handleAssign validation)
- TC-API-04-46: POST /tasks/:id/assign 409 when task is not PENDING status (handleAssign status check)
- TC-API-04-53: POST /tasks/:id/reassign 422 when user_id missing (handleReassign validation)
- TC-API-04-55: POST /tasks/:id/reassign 422 when user_id empty string (handleReassign validation)
- TC-API-04-56: POST /tasks/:id/reassign 409 when task is not PENDING status (handleReassign status check)

MEDIUM priority (skip with justification if not unit-testable):
- TC-API-04-08: GET /tasks status filter parsing (may need integration test)
- TC-API-04-14: GET /tasks instance_id filter parsing (may need integration test)

LOW priority (skip with justification):
- TC-API-04-06: cursor cross-endpoint prefix test

Use mock/stub patterns already established in the test file. For cases where a handler requires a real DB interaction that cannot be mocked, add a SkipZigTest attribute with a comment explaining why integration test is needed.

After adding tests, run zig build test and verify exit 0.
